Standalone PDF text extraction using extract

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"filename\":\"fake_memo.pdf\",\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"application/pdf\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf\"}")
    result = await extract(input)
    print(result.results[0].metadata)

asyncio.run(main())
```
